newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Norway August CPI seen steady from July.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Norway August CPI seen steady from July.

text.p: Eight economists polled by Reuters expected Norway's August consumer price index to be unchanged with year-on-year inflation at 1.5 percent.
Economists' forecasts ranged from -0.2 and +0.1 percent for the monthly figure, due at 0745 GMT on September 10.
The average estimate for all of 1996 was 1.3 percent, while 1997 inflation was forecast at 2.4 percent.
Contributors to the poll were Union Bank of Norway, SE Banken, Christiania Bank, Orkla Finans, Den Danske Bank, Fiba Nordic Securities, Elcon Securities and Case Manhattan.
